reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Sales finance company license requirement and exemptions
headings.reviewNote: License required to engage in business as sales finance company; exempts banks, trust companies, S&Ls, and small loan registrants.

headings.title: Sworn license application and required disclosures
headings.reviewNote: Application must be in writing under oath with business addresses, organizational identity, and officer/director names.

headings.title: License fees, account volume tier, and licensing period
headings.reviewNote: Fee schedule not to exceed $5,000 plus branch fees, $1,000 low-volume cap, calendar year term, and consumer licensing fund credit.

headings.title: Display of license and address change endorsement
headings.reviewNote: License must specify office/branch and be displayed; director endorses location change without charge.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed sales finance licensing, institutional exemptions, sworn disclosures, tiered calendar-year fees, and license display/relocation.

headings.title: Grounds for renewal denial, suspension, or revocation
headings.reviewNote: Four grounds for denying renewal or suspending/revoking license: application misstatements, willful contract violations, defrauding buyers, and chapter misrepresentations.

headings.title: Imputation of officer, partner, and employee acts
headings.reviewNote: Entity responsibility for acts of officers, partners, and employees upon knowledge and retention of benefits.

headings.title: Hearing and review under chapter 536
headings.reviewNote: Disciplinary action prohibited except after hearing conducted pursuant to chapter 536.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; refined subsections (1) and (3) titles for renewal-denial precision and chapter 536 hearing/review citation.

headings.title: Investigative authority and production of business records
headings.reviewNote: Director power to investigate transactions and compel production of books, records, accounts, and documents.

headings.title: Retail buyer complaints and targeted inspections
headings.reviewNote: Buyer written complaint procedure for statutory violations and director inspection of pertinent licensee and seller records.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; refined subsection (1) title to reflect compelling production of records rather than subpoena terminology.

headings.title: Promulgation of administrative rules and advance mailing
headings.reviewNote: Rulemaking authority; fifteen days advance mailing to licensees and institutions; promulgation pursuant to section 536.024.

headings.title: Subpoena and oath administration powers
headings.reviewNote: Director power to subpoena witnesses and evidence and administer oaths in all matters within jurisdiction.

headings.title: Judicial subpoena enforcement by circuit court
headings.reviewNote: Application to circuit judge upon refusal to obey subpoena; clerk issues judicial subpoena under seal.

headings.title: Contempt proceedings and judicial penalties
headings.reviewNote: Attachment for arrest, hearing, fine up to $100, jail imprisonment, and costs for subpoena noncompliance.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed rulemaking advance mailing, section 536.024 compliance, subpoena/oath powers, judicial enforcement, and contempt sanctions.

headings.title: Written contract requirements and negotiable promissory notes
headings.reviewNote: Contract must be in writing signed by both parties; promissory notes permitted if stating prepayment privileges and refunds.

headings.title: Type size and mandatory buyer notice
headings.reviewNote: Eight-point type minimum and ten-point bold buyer notice warning against signing blank contracts and explaining refund rights.

headings.title: Liability insurance exclusion notice requirement
headings.reviewNote: Ten-point bold statement required specifying if bodily injury and property damage liability insurance is excluded.

headings.title: Delivery of copy and buyer right of rescission
headings.reviewNote: Seller must deliver signed copy; buyer may rescind prior to vehicle delivery; ten-point bold acknowledgment required.

headings.title: Identification of parties and motor vehicle description
headings.reviewNote: Contract must state names and addresses of buyer and seller, and describe motor vehicle make, year, model, and identification numbers.

headings.title: Itemized financial disclosures in contract
headings.reviewNote: Twelve itemized financial disclosures including cash price, down payment, insurance, fees, principal, differential, and time price balance.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 6 subsections, mandatory buyer notice text, and 12 itemized disclosures against archived text; refined subsection (3) title to clarify liability insurance exclusion notice.

headings.title: Insurance charge limits, authorized carriers, and policy delivery
headings.reviewNote: Charges limited to approved rates; vehicle coverage limited to physical damage; 30-day policy delivery window; buyer choice of broker.

headings.title: Crediting of insurance premium refunds
headings.reviewNote: Insurance refunds or premium adjustments must be credited to final maturing installments of contract.

headings.title: Life insurance maximum coverage limits
headings.reviewNote: Life insurance restricted to unpaid balance, with level term exception for unequal installment schedules.

headings.title: Authorization for ancillary vehicle protection products
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies authorization to sell GAP waivers, extended service contracts, and similar products at time of sale.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 4 subsections and Effective 8-28-05 note against archived text; confirmed insurance rate caps, 30-day delivery, refund crediting, life insurance limits, and ancillary vehicle products.

headings.title: Delinquency charges, attorney fees, and servicing expenses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes late charge (up to $25 or 5%), contract interest, attorney fees up to 15%, returned check fee, and servicing costs.

headings.title: Alternative payment channel convenience fees
headings.reviewNote: Flat or fixed convenience fee permitted for remote debit/credit card payments with prior notice.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed August 28, 2005 contract scope, permissive late/interest/attorney/returned-check/servicing charges, and card convenience fees.

headings.title: Agreed time price differential rate
headings.reviewNote: Retail seller authorized to charge and receive any agreed time price differential expressed as an annual percentage.

headings.title: Computation and minimum time price differential
headings.reviewNote: Time price differential computed on principal balance; authorizes $25 minimum charge on retail installment transactions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed agreed percent-per-annum time price differential and $25 permissive minimum charge.

headings.title: Assignment of retail installment contracts
headings.reviewNote: Validity of contract assignments without filing or buyer notice; payments to last known holder protect buyer.

headings.title: Contract extensions, deferrals, and refinancing charges
headings.reviewNote: Deferrals and refinancing terms confirmed in writing; calculates refinancing charges, credit refunds, and official fees.

headings.title: Alternative deferral fees on larger contracts
headings.reviewNote: Optional advance deferral fee up to $50 or 10% on nonprecomputed contracts of $600 or more after first recurring payment.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; confirmed assignment validity, extension/deferral/refinance computation, and alternative advance deferral fees on nonprecomputed contracts of $600+.

headings.title: Class B misdemeanor for knowing or unlicensed violations
headings.reviewNote: Class B misdemeanor penalty for knowing statutory violations or unlicensed operation of sales finance business.

headings.title: Civil forfeiture of finance charges
headings.reviewNote: Bar against recovery of time price differential, delinquency, or collection charges for specified statutory violations.

headings.title: Thirty-day safe harbor for noncompliance correction
headings.reviewNote: Correction of noncompliance within thirty days of sale shields seller or holder from criminal and civil penalties.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified all 3 subsections and history note against archived text; refined subsection (1) title to match "knowingly violates" standard rather than "willful" and confirmed civil forfeiture and 30-day cure.

headings.title: Trade-in loan or lease balance and definitions
headings.reviewNote: Seller permitted to roll over negative equity from prior loan or lease on trade-in; defines time sale contract and motor vehicle.

headings.title: Retail seller qualification prerequisite
headings.reviewNote: Seller must qualify as retail seller under sections 365.010 to 365.160 to utilize negative equity trade-in provisions.

entries.reviewSummary: Verified both subsections and Effective 3-01-11 note against archived text; refined subsection (1) title to cover trade-in loan or lease balance inclusion and section definitions for vehicles outside 365.010–365.160.
